chats.cameraType.reason: Exact CameraType enum selects Android Camera1/Camera2/CameraX implementations. Native Legacy/Neo capture has different modes; these ordinals cannot select a native camera pipeline.

evidence.note: chats.cameraType native Legacy/Neo adaptation, no Android enum key

chats.unmuteWithVolumeButtons.reason: Exact contract consumes Android hardware-volume KeyEvents for unmute. This native client has no equivalent consumable hardware-key event; output-volume observation is not that event/override.
